standard-dialogue-pre-sailing-release.speaker: Anne
standard-dialogue-pre-sailing-release.text: Ah, look what we have here, Will! This looks like someone who needs a good job!

standard-dialogue-pre-sailing-release.npc: Goodness, Anne, I think you're right! This one's clearly never worked an honest day in their life, and it's about time someone changed that!

standard-dialogue-pre-sailing-release.speaker: Anne
standard-dialogue-pre-sailing-release.text: Alas! We are sadly not currently in a place where we can take on any more staff, but let us hope that changes soon!
The Sailing skill will release on the 19th November.
